svg.title: Intelligence inside a large-document workflow
svg.desc: The same workflow top to bottom: five steps with the model's question at each, a human-review detour, a page-cited result, and a gold-set measurement loop showing ~70% to ~90% extraction accuracy.

g.text: each value stays tied to its page
